acceptance: The drawer, the outline badges and the edit dialog's Orchestration section join GET /api/orchestration's leaves on the outline node's id (the snapshot keys leaves by node id, as specy_road/orchestration/state.py and the M16.3.1 parity goldens do); a leaf in the outline renders under its outline id and title, and only a leaf id absent from the outline renders as missing from it. The server's snapshot is unchanged

The GUI's worker status type is the record states the snapshot sends (starting, running, idle, paused_by_limit, completed, failed, terminated); the badge step M17.1 set for a failed worker matches state failed, at the same precedence (above stalled); no other badge precedence changes

The GUI tests and the orchestration mock fixture use node-id keys and record states as the snapshot sends them, with one test that fails on the old node_key join (a leaf present in the outline must not render as missing); npm ci, lint, test and build pass in gui/pm-gantt and the rebuilt specy_road/pm_gantt_static is committed
docs/pm-gui.md says leaves are keyed by node id and lists the worker states the snapshot sends; CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] records the fix; no version heading is written
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): GUI about +-40 plus the rebuilt bundle
